data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 冰霜符文法阵中的女武神咏唱
data.description: 极北冰雪荒原之上，前女武神罗丝薇瑟身披银白战铠，脚下巨大的北欧如尼冰霜魔法阵升腾，法杖挥洒绝对零度的神圣冰晶。
data.action: 高举卢恩符文法杖引导法术，银发在暴风雪中激荡，战裙铠甲在极光下熠熠生辉
data.lighting: 天穹绿色绚烂极光与脚下冰蓝魔法光芒交相辉映
data.camera: 大角度斜向仰拍，突出魔法阵宏大尺度与女武神凛然神威
data.promptProse: Rossweisse commands absolute zero frost magic atop an arctic glacial wasteland under a swirling emerald aurora borealis. Dressed in her full silver-and-white Valkyrie plate armor with deep blue accents, she thrusts her glowing runic staff high into the blizzard. A massive, intricate Nordic ice magic circle flares beneath her boots, channeling blinding shards of crystalline frost with majestic authority.
data.animaCaption: Raising her runic staff above a roaring ice magic circle, Valkyrie Rossweisse commands the arctic storm beneath dancing auroras.
